title: Filtermos
description: Filtermos is a Minecraft 1.21.8 mod for Fabric. It lets you define an item filter list: any item on that list will not be picked up when it is on the ground, so your inventory is not filled with unwanted drops (e.g. rotten flesh or cobb
body:
## Features

- **Filter pickups by item**: Items you select in the config screen will not be picked up in-game.
- **Per-player config**: Each player has their own filter list (currently stored in memory; server restart clears it).
- **Visual item selector**: Choose items from a GUI with search and scroll.

### How to Use

1. **Open the config screen**
   - Press **G** in-game, or
   - Open **Mod Menu** → this mod → **Config**.
2. **Choose items to filter**
   - Click item slots to toggle them on/off.
   - Use the search box to filter by name or item ID.
   - Use the mouse wheel to scroll the list.
3. **Save**
   - Click **「完成」 (Done)**; the list is sent to the server and applied immediately.

### Requirements

- Minecraft **1.21.8**
- **Fabric Loader** (≥ 0.18.4)
- **Fabric API**
- Java **21+**

### Installation

1. Install Fabric and Fabric API.
2. Put the mod jar into your `.minecraft/mods` folder.
3. Launch the game.
